integrity: All polynomial claims are checked with exact rational arithmetic. The certificate verifies projective smoothness of the generators, nine transverse real base points, twenty-one simple real critical points, twelve non-base singular starts, nondegenerate nodal Hessians, absence of singularities at infinity, and twelve distinct real critical values.
scientific_limitations: This is one explicit cubic--cubic witness, not a solution for all degree pairs. Classical real algebraic geometry already establishes broad existence of pencils with twelve real singular cubics; the contribution is the specific integral pair and an exact Newton-homotopy certificate satisfying the 2026 framework.
title: An exact integral cubic-pair witness attaining twelve real Newton singular starts
